sanskrit: gurave ca gaṇeśāya kārtikeyāya dhīmate ukta svapnāvabodhasya tattvataḥ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha sarvāṇyetāni yo vetti sa yogaṃ yoktu marhati yatparā paramaiśvaryametaddhyāna prayojanam harṣaṃ bhayaṃ viṣādaṃ ca satyajan yogamabhyaset nadītīre viviktenta gṛhe ghoravanepi vā yogadoṣa vinimukte nirvikalpe nirātape yogācāryānnamaskṛtya yogaṃ yuñjīta * * * pīṭhārdhatardhacandraṃ vā karmato? bhadrameva vā sarvasaṃgān parityajyātmasasthaṃ manoguha kiñcit kuñcita netrastu śivaṃ samyaktadoccaret punarvinaṃśikaścaivāstra yuktaṣṣaḍānana varmāstra netrasahitaṃ tasmādeva pravartate tayorvṛttirnirudhyātmā śivaṃ dhyāyed vicakṣaṇaḥ susūkṣmaṃ vyāpakaṃ nityaṃ nirvikalpaṃ sadā budhaḥ prāṇāyāmāṃśca tān kuryāt pūrakumbhaka recakān prāṇāyāmo bhavādeya pūrako dehapūrakaḥ saṃpūrṇa kumbhavat tiṣṭhet prāṇāyāmassakumbhakaḥ recakastveṣa vikhyātaḥ prāṇasaṃśayakārakaḥ cchoṭikā tato dadyānmanannaiṣṭā tvabhidhīyate tāladvādaśakaṃ jñeyaṃ prāṇāyāmastu ānyasam ekaikāṃ vardhamātrāṃ pratyahaṃ yogavittamaḥ prāṇāyāmottamoyatta dviguṇā dhāraṇā matā yogasiddhiriti jñeyā śivena paramātmanā rasaṃ tejaspariśaṃti ca śabdatanmātrameva ca

ahaṃkāra manobuddhiṃ guṇamavyakta pauruṣam vidyāṃ kalāṃ tataḥ kālaṃ māyāṃ vidyāṃ tataḥ parām vidyeśvaraṃ tatastatvaṃ tathā sādāśivaṃ param amṛtātmā śivaḥ sākṣāt tasminniṣṭastu yogavit sarveṣveva sa śāstreṣu jñeyaṃ vastu catuṣṭayam jñātvā tu tatva sadbhāvaṃ tantrasāraṃ tu durlabham sarvathā vartamānopi gṛhṇāti na punastanum saṃyogaṃ ca tathā teṣāṃ kathayasva maheśvara kā pāśāḥ komalāḥ proktāḥ kasmādvandhaḥ pumāniti śivaśca kīdṛśaḥ prokto yodhikāra vivarjitaḥ samamūḍho nityasaṃsārī kiñcid jñānīśvaro kritaḥ antarlūnaṃ tathā jñeyaṃ śivatvaṃ pudgalasya tu tathātmā jñānasambandhaśśivatvaṃ pratipadyate tathātmā pāśasaṃśliṣṭa avibhāgena saṃsthitaḥ kurute pāśaviśleṣaṃ tathācāryaḥ śivādhvaraiḥ tathā hi sarvapāśānāṃ sannirodhastu dīkṣayā tathācāryo dahetpuṃsāṃ vāyubhūto malāvubhau sahajau sādhakajñānāṃ tāmrakālikavātsthitau sāṃsargikāstathā bhūyaḥ śṛṇu teṣu vinirṇayam te tu pāśāḥ parāḥ proktāssahajāssarvajantuṣu āgantukāḥ smṛtāḥ hyete tasmāt sāṃsargikāḥ punaḥ te tu sāṃsargikāḥ pāśāḥ sukhaduḥkhaphalaḥ pradā pūrvopārjita karmāṇāṃ bhāvaḥ saṃyoga kārakaḥ karmodayād bhavet sṛṣṭirasāstaiḥ pralayaṃ viduḥ vandhamāpnoti puruṣo hyakarto sarvagopi san

akartāpīha puruṣastathā bandhamavāpnuyāt tathābandhamavāpnoti tathā jñeyastu pudgalaḥ tacchedakastathānādiḥ paśupāśapatistusaḥ sarvamantrādhipaścāsau sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ aśeṣa bhavanādhāro yogapīṭhāsanasthitaḥ sthūlasūkṣmopi miśraścaivaṃ rūpaṃ tu saṃskṛtaḥ nirāmayo nirādhāro varṇarūpa vivarjitaḥ atīndriyo nirālambaḥ susūkṣmaḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ bahirantarvibhāgena tiletailamiva sthitaḥ agrāhyasyāpi sūkṣmasya sarvagasya tu niṣkalam na kasya vijāyākhyātaṃ tadvijñānaṃ śṛṇuṣva me bhavabandhavimokṣārthaṃ paramaṃ sarvatomukham sarvatatvamayo cintyassarvasyopari saṃsthitaḥ sohamevamupāsīta nirvikalpena cetasā nirvikalpamanod deśyaṃ hetu dṛṣṭāntavarjitam avibhāṣyamasandehaṃ tadahaṃ nātrasaṃśayaḥ sarvamantravyatītaśca sṛṣṭisaṃhāravarjitaḥ ahameva jagannātho mattaḥ sarvaṃ prakāśate śivādyavani paryantaṃ tatsarvaṃ mayi saṃsthitam bahirantarvibhāgena tatsarvaṃ vyāpitaṃ mayā evamupāsayenmohānna śivatvamavāpnuyāt yaḥ śivaḥ sohameveti advaitaṃ bhāvayet sadā sarvagaṃ sarvadehasthaṃ paśyate nātrasaṃśayaḥ sarvajñatvaṃ pravarteta vikalparahitasya ca akāyo nirguṇo hyātmā so'hamasminna saṃśayaḥ

vijñātaśāśvataśśuddhassa śivo nātra saṃśayaḥ parāparavibhāgena sthūla sūkṣmavibhāgaśaḥ sthūlo mantramayaḥ proktaḥ sūkṣmo dhyānaika saṃsthitaḥ vāgvikalpa viśeṣeṇa manaḥ saṃmohakāriṇī tattadbhavatyasaṃdehāt sadā tadbhāva bhāvataḥ jñātvaivātmamayaṃ sarvamātmānaṃ paryupāsate ātmavijñānamāśritya vimalaṃ sarvato mukham nānyaḥ śaraṇadaḥ kaścidātmajñānādṛteḥ kvacit sa mucyate tvayatnena sarvāvasthāṃ gatopi san tathātmānamupāsīta yoyamātmāparastu saḥ sarvajñaṃ tu tamātmānaṃ paripūrṇaṃ sadā smaret sa niṣkale pare sthāne tatra cittaṃ niveśayet sarvaśūnyaṃ tamābhāsa samātmānaṃ bhāvayettha pakṣapāta vinirmuktamātmānaṃ paryupāsayet nirañjanaṃ guṇātītamātmānaṃ paryupāsayet svabhāvavimalaṃ nityamātmānaṃ paryupāsayet bhāvayedātmanātmānaṃ mātmanyevātmani sthitam bhāvānetān parityajya svarūpaṃ bhāvayed budhaḥ sarvabhāvān parityajyātmābhāvaṃ tu bhāvayet ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayet pakṣapāta vinirmuktamātmānaṃ paryupāsayet nistatve niṣkalī bhūte vindatyātmani yatsukham tatsukhaṃ paramaṃ proktamātyantikamanaupamam yadā yātyunmanī bhāvaṃ tadā tatparamaṃ sukham sarvavarṇāśramāṇāṃ ca jñānabhedo na vidyate

kṣīravat paśyate jñānamaṅginastu gavāṃsamāḥ tasmādbrahmaṇi saṃsthāne digdeśānna vicārayet na liṅgaṃ nāśramācāraḥ paramātmani saṃsthitaḥ sarvadā sarvakāleṣu vātaśītātapeṣu ca ātmanyeṣa sthitaḥ śāntaḥ ātmatṛptastu niṣkalaḥ na bhūto na bhaviṣyāmi prakṛtya sthira dharmaṇi nāhaṃ kiñcit karomīti yuktamanyeta tatvavit na caiva prākṛtairdoṣairlipye * * kadācana ābhātyevaṃ parohyātmātsyaikvaivā(?) jñānajaṃtapaḥ tathātmā bhāvanāyukta svātmanye vā valiṣṭhate ghaṭo niyatinākāśamākāśatvaṃ prapadyate ityevamadhikāreṇa sarvajñenādhikāriṇā sarvabandhādvinirmuktassarvajñaḥ sarvago bhavet asmātparaṃ nānyadihāsti kiñcid jñātvaiva saṃtyajya manovikalpam sarvatragāmī bharatīha muktastaddharmadharmī bahirantasaṃsthaḥ anantaśaktiśca nirāmayātmā viśuddhadehassa śivatvameti dharmādharmaphalaṃ nāsti na piṇḍo nodaka kriyā pravṛttiṃ na nivṛttiśca brahmacaryavratāni ca śivajñānāmṛtaṃ pītvā vicarasva yathāsukham satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ trisatyaṃ samayaḥ kṛtaḥ vimalayati sarvabhāvān vimalātmā vimalabuddhirataśudhīḥ jāgrajāgrajāgrasvapnaṃ tathā jāgrasuṣuptikam viśvāgrasvopaśāntaśca śivadarśanameva ca sāyujyamiti bhedena cordhvamekādaśa smṛtaḥ pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca

puruṣādhiṣṭhitairvījaistanmātrairvījasaṃyutaiḥ sarvendriya samāyuktaṃ śarīramiti cocyate satvarajastama iti puruṣasya svabhāvabhedaṃ kurvanti satvaprakāśakaṃ bhāvaṃ rajo rājātmakaṃ guha satvātsaṃjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lopameva ca satyātsatyaṃ dayā dhairyaṃ vinayasthairyameva ca ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti satvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ rajastamaścābhi bhūyasatvaṃ vardhati ṣaṇmukha yameva svete puruṣo atisaṃgātsadā guṇam evameka kapālasya ṣoḍaśa pārśvapaṭalāni bhavanti majjāpaṃcaprastāmedaḥ prasthadvayaṃ tristordhvaṃ romakoṭyaḥ yottare vartate śabdastasya vācā pravartakaḥ tasmācca sarvaśāstrāṇi saṃskṛta prākṛtāni ca paśvaśca mṛgāścaiva pakṣiṇaśca sarīsṛpāḥ sūkṣmā vai pañcatanmātrā mano'haṃkāra eva ca kalākālastathā māyā vidyāvidyeśvaraṃ ca yat eteṣāṃ caiva saṃyogāt tatvātmā puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ susūkṣmāḥ sarvagānityassahajā sarva ṛtuṣu na paraṃ prakriyā jñānāt na śilādvyāpakaṃ param udayo yakṣya tatvasya dehe bhavati ṣaṇmukha yasmiṃścarati bhūtātmā tattatvaṃ vṛṣasarpate muhurmuhu sā dehī sarvatatvairanukramāt tacca tasya sadā skanda tatvabhāvaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ tathā tatvādhipān bhāvān pragṛhṇāti ṣaḍānana yasmiṃ sthite ratiṃ yāti tameva parisevate

tasmiṃstatve sthitiṃ vidyāt tattatkarma samācaret na punarmoha māyāti tasmiṃścaiva ṣaḍānana dehī sarvagataḥ sūkṣmaḥ purāṇaḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ asvatantro nibaddhaśca cinmātro maladūṣiteḥ paśudharmosya saṃjñeyaḥ śivadharmastano'nyathā ātmā jantuḥ pumān dehī puruṣaḥ pudgalī tathā sarve dharmātmanaḥ santi saṃyuktaḥ sarvakarmabhiḥ yāvannotpadyate jñānaṃ tāvadbhamati karmaṇā jñānī labdhvā paraṃ śāntaṃ macireṇādhi gacchati sarvaśokaharaṃdīptaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃparam pitṛmātṛgaṇānāñca siddhavidyādharādiṣu śivādi sarvatatvānāṃ mantrāvidyanti śāśvatāḥ yāvantaḥ kecanassatvā mantrādhiṣṭhita vigrahāḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ trayodaśāntaṃ ca tasmin tasmin niyojayet bindunālaṃkṛtaṃ mūrdhna sarvakāmaphalapradam dīrghabhinnā smṛtā hyaṅgā netrānusvārasaṃyutaḥ iti teṣāṃ tu bījānāṃ mūrdhni binduṃ pradāpayet arcane ca prayoktavyā home svāhānta yojitāḥ snapane mantravinyāse dhāraṇādhyānakarmasu śivasya yo vidhiḥ proktaḥ sarvakarmakrameṣu ca anuktaṃ yad bhavet kiñcit tatsarvaṃ hṛdayena tu paramīkaraṇaṃ proktaṃ sarvatatveṣu mantravit sthūla sūkṣma parassohi mantrātma puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ paraḥ parama nirvāṇaṃ yaṃ prāpya na nirvartate tathāhi mantraḥ parikalpyamāno bhavatyanekaḥ punareka eva

tathaiva mantrasya ca veditavyaṃ jātyantaraṃ hyekamenaka rūpam tadātmaka smṛtā hyaṅgā bahirāhita dvibhāgahāḥ tādṛśopyupacārastu mantradevānurūpataḥ tathā rūpo bhavenmantrastataḥ karmaprasādhayet sarvopāśraya sampannaṃ sphaṭiko kopalavadyathā sarvajñaḥ sarvagaścaiva sarvarūpa mayo hi saḥ nirāmayaṃ nirādhāraṃ varṇarūpa vivarjitam atīndriyo nirālambaḥ susūkṣmaḥ śāśvato vyathaḥ niraupaumyau prameyaśca parātmā prakīrtitaḥ ekadhā bahudhā caiva tathaiva pratipadyate sarvakāmaprado hyātmā proktaṣṣaḍbheda vistaraḥ mantrātmā paramākhyāśca ekopi bahudhā sthitaḥ mantrātmā mantraṃ yo jñeyo hyantarātmāgirānvitaḥ jitvā svabhuvanaṃ teṣāmebhirmuktaḥ parastuḥ prāptopi sa dvidhā bhāvi punarbhāvamavāpnuyāt tatvaviśleṣa kāle cādvaitaṃ pratipadyate ekasya bahunāmāni pṛthagbhūtānya koṭibhiḥ yathābhivyajyate jñānaṃ vimalaṃ sarvatomukham ahameva parohyātmā puruṣaḥ kāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ sarve vināśakābhāvāṃ mana eva pṛthagvidhāḥ yogasaṃnyasta karmāyo jñānasaṃbhinna saṃśayaḥ padārthāneka sampūrṇa sarvavāṅmaya sādhanam yo'sāvatīndriyo grāhyastatvātīto niraṃjanaḥ tasmācchāstraṃ viniṣkrāntaṃ nādarūpaṃ nirāmayam paramīkaraṇaṃ caiva brūhi tatvena śaṅkara

kakārādi kṣakārāntaṃ svarasaṃyogapūrvakam hrasvai brahmasamākhyātā dīrghairaṅgāni nirdiśet sa visargā smṛtā hyastrā anusvāravivarjitāḥ mātrātrayasamāyuktaṃ mūrdhni bindu pra * payet hrasvadīrghaplutānantānya yā kāmaṃ prakalpayet yadhi krodhenasaṃyukto japet saṃraktalocanaḥ mahāṃstu sādhako bhūtvā sādhyanūnaṃ prakalpayet tatrasya evādvayo bhūtvā teneva karṣayet punaḥ padmakośasthitaṃ taṃ tu saṃhareddhṛdayena tu japet tad bhāvanā yukto nāmaṃ mantrapi darhitam namaskārāntasaṃyuktānārcane saṃprayojayet vaśye ca saṃprayoktavyā svāhākārāntasaṃyutām sarvasādhāraṇaṃ vatsa śṛṇu saṃkṣepavistaram tameva sarvamātrāṇāṃ satataṃ parikalpayet atiguhyaṃ paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ sarvamantramayasya tu sā śaktiḥ paramāsūkṣmā viśvāsa dadātmikā kariṇīya karaṃ yadvat saṃveṣyorasi saṃsthitā saṃpradāyena sātūrṇamātmānaṃ muñcate śubhā prakāśayati cātmānaṃ mokṣadvāraṃ parāparam madhyadeśamanuprāpya tyajet tāṃ cañcalāṃ striyam tanmūlaṃ jāyate yena bhodhakassobhidhīyate dīrghosu nāśiko nādo hyaprameyo hyanaupamaḥ prāsādaṣṣaṣṭhasaṃyuktaḥ punaḥ ṣaṣṭhānta yojitaḥ sa śivaḥ śāśvataḥ proktaḥ sarvajñānottarottaraḥ hrasvasvarasamāyogā pañcabrahmāṇi nirdiśet

mūrdhni bindu suṣumnāsyāṃ gāyatrīṃ tāṃ vinirdiśet netratrayaṃ tu tajjñeyaṃ kramaśaḥ saṃprayojayet lalāṭe śivatatvaṃ tu trīṇi pañcasu vinyaset vinyasedātmanaḥ pūrvaṃ śivasya ca tathā punaḥ gaṇeśānāṃ tu gāyatrīṃ tasmin sānnidhyamāgatāḥ astrapāśupataṃ dīptastra mantraṃ prakalpayet viśvakīdviśvavettāro viśvakṛdviśva mūrtayaḥ arccate saṃprayoktavyā home svāhāntasaṃyutāḥ sa visargāstathā dīptā ghorakarmakarā smṛtāḥ kakārārdhayutaṃ kṛtvā kṣarikāstraṃ prakīrtitam sarvairebhiḥ sadā kuryācchivīkaraṇamātmanaḥ kupitakarakāyeṣu mantrimantrārya siddhaye yatkṛtvā tu naraḥ samyak śivo bhavati nānyathā śuddhadehastato bhūtvā śivamantrān niyojayet tasya madhye tu huṃkāraṃ jvalantaṃ pāvakaprabham utchra?ṭāntestra mokṣastu huṃkāreṇa samanvitaḥ sanniruddhe kṛte samyak gūrdhvaṃ vāyuḥ pravartate pūrakeṇopasaṃhṛtya hṛdayena tu mantravit huṃkārasya śikhāntasya puruṣaṃ bījavigraham tataḥ saṃyojayed yogī śive paramakāraṇe ekenodghāta mātreṇa ekalakṣassumantritaḥ bījavṛtyāśikhelūna tatva vṛtyā tu tatvavit hṛdā tu pārthivaṃ bījaṃ vāruṇaṃ śirasā saha hokāra mantrasaṃyuktaṃ maṇḍaleṣu prayojayet vaindavāstu kalāstāśca nivṛtyādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ

jñānatvaitāstu kalāsamyak sthūla sūkṣmavimiśrakāḥ caturaśraṃ samaṃpītaṃ vajrāṃga vajrāṅgaṃ kaṭhinaṃ gurum udghātaiḥ pañcabhiryuktaṃ vāyubhūta viśodhayet yuktaṃ caturbhirudghātaiḥ vahnibhūtaṃ viśodhayet varṣantaṃ tamabhidhyāyet nādamānaṃ suśītalam tryayaśramarcassusampannamāgneyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ smaret udghātai stribhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ jalabhūtaṃ viśodhayet yakārāsan saṃviṣṭaṃ kavacaṃ vāyuvigraham tataḥ sañcintayed vyomaṃ samalaṃ sarvatomukham oṃkārāsaṃviṣṭaṃ hakāraṃ nāhasaṃvilam maṇḍalaṃ bījasaṃyuktaṃ dhyānena vividhena ca yāyeva dhāraṇādhārya jagatsarvaṃ hi tanmayam evaṃ saṃśuddha dehastvamṛtībhūto vidhānavit yasmin carati pudgalaḥ * * * * * * * * dehastasya videhasya jākṣibhūtasya karmasu vāmanāsā puṭe yā tu iḍāsā parikīrtitā yasminnabhyadhiko vāyussānāḍī sarvakāmadā piṅgalā nāḍi padmaṃ tu suṣumnā mūrdhni yogavit mūrdhnānte śivaṃ dhyāyet varadaṃ sarvatomukham sandhyāsu ca tato dhyānaṃ divā rātrau japa smṛtam sandhyāyāṃ sātvikaḥ prokto japaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ manasā sātvikaṃ vighāt japaṃ japyavidāṃ viduḥ sātvikaṃ divyasiddhīnāṃ japaṃ yujyādvicakṣaṇaḥ sa japaḥ sātvikaḥ prokto bhoga mokṣa phalapradaḥ dhyānena hi parāṃ siddhiṃ prāpnuvanti hi yoginaḥ

dvimārgāvasthitaṃ dhyāyet pūjāgnau homavittamaḥ na jātirūpaṃ paraṃ śuddhaṃ tatsūkṣmaṃ parikīrtitam sandhyā tu viṣuvaṃ proktaṃ vuttareṇa * * * * ? dakṣiṇenottaraṃ vidyāṃ madhye tu viṣuvaṃ bhavet viṣuvaṃ tu vijānīyāt puṇyamantro bhayātmakam iḍākhyāntargatāṃ dhyāyet pitṛyāne śikhiddhvaja piṃgalāntargataṃ dhyāyed devayānaṃ taducyate suṣumnāntargataṃ dhyāyed viṣuve ca vicakṣaṇaḥ yogapīṭhaṃ ca padmaṃ ca praṇavena tu vinyaset vyāpayanti madhaścordhvaṃ punaḥ śakti niyojayet pūrakeṇa śikhāntasthaṃ śivabījamayaṃparam amṛte vā plāvyamānamupariṣṭāt samaṃ tataḥ yathā bhavati tatvena tacchṛṇuṣva yathākramam īśānādīni brahmāṇi kaniṣṭhādiṣu yojayet prāsādaṃ vinyaset pañcadvyāpinaṃ sarvatomukham īśānaṃ pañcadhā mūrdhni vaktraṃvaktra catuṣṭaye hṛdādyaṃgairaghoraṃ tu guhyavāmaṃ prakalpayet hṛdi śrīvātadānau ca nābhyāṃ ca jaṭhare tathā guhye caiva tathāliṅge ūrvorvaijānunostathā pādayorhastayoścaiva nāsāyāṃ śirasā tathā netraṃ netreṣu vinyasya punaraṃgāni yojayet śikhāyāṃ tu śikhādyā tu kavacaṃ stanamadhyataḥ śivasya yādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ tādṛśaṃ cintayātmani yathāntardeha vinyāsastathā bāhyepi ṣaṇmukha tathā vai śiṣya dehe tu agnau home tathaiva ca

sarvakāmapradaṃ guhyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ param śivībhūtaḥ supūtātmā śivasyārcanamārabhet vighnānuccāṭayet sthūlāt tālaśabda trayeṇa tu punarāveṣṭayenmantrī tatsthānaṃ kavacena tu vajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṃkuśam aindrī diśaṃ samārabhya yāvadīśānagocaram gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpaiḥ punarastrāṇi pūjayet vyāpayanti hyadhaścordhvamaprameyāṃ manaupamām sa bāhyābhyantaraṃ paścāt kavacenāvakuṇṭhayet tritatvaṃ vinyaset tasmin punaḥ śaktiṃ niyojayet gandhapuṣpasamāyuktaṃ tajjalaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtam aṅgairaṅgīkṛtaṃ vatsa śuddhasphaṭikanirmalam aprokṣitaṃ na tā divyaṃ bhaviṣyatvaṃ ca vai śive dharmādi cāstraparyantaṃ śivavarja ṣaḍānana saṃpūrṇāhuti dāne ca sarvakarma samarpaṇe āgneyaṃ diśamāśritya vidikṣu praṇavena tu yogapīṭhaṃ tataḥ paścācchaktinālaṃ ca paṅkajam tribhāgakeparākīrṇaṃ śaktijālavitānitam balapramathanī sarvabhūtadamanī manonmanī hṛdayena tu vinyasya kesareṣu daleṣu ca īśānaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu śivavyoma prakalpayet sitavarṇanibhaṃ dhyātvā pūrvavaktre tu pudgalam sadyaḥ paścima bhāge tu tatohyāvāhanaṃ bhavet aghoreṇa tu sānnidhyamarghyaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tu varṇarūpaka saṃyuktaṃ punaḥ pūjāṃ prakalpayet

dīptatejassitoktānāṃ pañcamaṃ praṇavena tu pādādārabhya sarvāṅgaiḥ sadyojātaṃ tu vinyaset pṛṣṭhe hyurasi mantrajño vinyased bahurūpakam jaṃghayośca sphicau kaṭyāṃ pārśve vāmakalā nyaset sadyojāta kalāhyevaṃ tatassarvatra mūrtiṣu hṛdayaṃ hṛdaye nyasya śiraṃ śirasi vinyaset astraṃ hastapradeśe tu punaraṅgāni niyojayet nair-ṛtyāṃ tu śikhāṃ dadyāt vāyavyāṃ kavacaṃ nyaset pūrvādārabhyamantrajño gāyatrīṃ vidiśāsu ca ananteśaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ ca śivaṃ ca punaruttamam śrīkaṇṭhaṃ ca śikhaṇḍīśaṃ yugāntādityasannibhāḥ gaṇeśvarāṃścaturthe tu kauberyāśādiśaḥ kramāt gaṇādhyakṣaṃ ca bhṛṅgīśaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ skandameva ca pañcame lokapālāstu kramādāvaraṇe budhaḥ indraṃ ca pāvakaṃ caiva yamaṃ nir-ṛtimeva ca vidyeśvara gaṇeśānāmānanaṃ praṇavaṃ viduḥ vinyasyaivaṃ vidhānena tataḥ saṃpūjayecchivam saṃśliṣṭa ratnapādāntaṃ śaṅkhacakrāmbujāṅkitam vistīrṇa kaṭyurasakaṃ pīnavakṣasthalāṃsakam sthūlabāhu śiroskandhaṃ nimnanābhiṃ kṛśodaram subhrūlalāṭabimboṣṭha karṇanāsaṃ sumūrdhajam tryakṣaṃ daśabhujaṃ śāntaṃ jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitam baddhapadmāsanaṃ saumyaṃ kiñcit kuñcitalocanam divyagandhānuliptāṅgaṃ divyāmbaramanoharam dhyātvātvevaṃ vidhaṃ mantrī sarvakāmaphalapradam

snāpayet sadya bījena kavacena vilepayet īśānena tu puṣpāṇi makuṭaṃ kuṇḍalāni ca aghoreṇa pradātavyaṃ dhūpaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tu gandhapuṣpāṇi dhūpañca dīpaṃ cātra pradāpayet nivedyārghyaṃ tu devasya tato mudrāṃ pradarśayet coṭikā mudrāḥ tataḥ padmaḥ liṅgañca dravyarūpiṇi gandhadigdhau karau kṛtvā mudrāṃ samyak prapūjayet mukheṣvācamanīyañca śirassvarghyaṃ nidhojayet visarjane tṛtīyantu devasyārghyaṃ prakalpayet madhye caiva tu mantrajñaḥ pañcasvarghyaṃ niyojayet ūrdhvavaktre tu dātavyaṃ samukhaṃ ca parāṅmukham visarjane tu gāṅgeyaṃ deyamarghyaṃ parāṅmukham bhakṣyā bhojyānna pānādi lehyaśoṣyānyanekaśaḥ punarāvaṇairdattyāt naivedyaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtam śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā kṛtvā bhūtabaliṃ haret dadyādbhūtabaliṃ mantrī sarvapākavimiśritam praviśyāyatanaṃ paścāt japaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaiḥ śikhāṃsthayekaṃcittaḥ sadā japet svastikaṃ vāsanaṃ baddhvā samakāyaśiraḥ sthitaḥ acirātsiddhimāpnoti adaitadaitamāśritaḥ āśrayaṃ sarvasiddhīnāmihāmutraphalapradam tatastvāveṣṭayet paścāt kavacena yathākramam punaracyukṣaṇaṃ paścāt kavacena vidhānavit tataḥ śaktiṃ nyaset tasmin taṭitsahasrasannibhām catuddhvaḥ svarasaṃbhinno vahnibījordhvadīpitaḥ

gandhapuṣpārcitāṃ kṛtvā arghyadhitva vidhānavit caturthena vinirmukto hyadhaṣṣaṣṭhaṃ niyojitaḥ tāmrapātreśarāve vā vadhitvā hutāśanam tatastvā veṣṭayet paścāt kavacena vidhānavit sadyojātena mantreṇa hṛdayaṃ tu punarjapet śirasābhyarcayitvā tu vāmadevaṃ tato japet aghoreṇārcayed devaṃ śikhābījaṃ tato japet kavacena samabhyarcya japet tatpuruṣaṃ vibhum īśānenārcayitvāstraṃ ca parivartayet janane padmamudrāsya liṅgamudrāgniyojane evamagniṃ susaṃskṛtvā mudrāḥ mantraiḥ yathākramam hṛdvījenāstareddarbhān paridhayaśca nidhāpayet brahmāṇaṃ śaṃkharaṃviṣṇumananteśa samanvitam āgnedhiṃdiśamāśrityājya bhāṇḍṃ tu sthāpayet prādeśamātrakān darbhān praścinnā nakhena tu tataḥ saṃplavanaṃ mantrī saṃmukhaṃ ghṛtamutpalavat saṃspṛśe tu kṛśaussarvamagra madhyāvasānakam hṛdayena vidhānajñaḥ sarvakarma samācaret punaradghāṭanaṃ kuryādastrabījena ṣaṇmukha śive some tathā vyaghnautastridhā parikalpayet tata trāsana vinyāsaṃ prāśuttaṃ parikalpayet pūjayitvā śivaṃ samyak tato homaṃ samārabhet vidrume lelihāne ca hunate yassasidhyate sniṃdha pradakṣiṇāvarto jātavedastu sidhvitaḥ durgandhaścaiva rūkṣaśca tatra siddhirna vidyate

viśuddhe pāvake śuddheranyathā viphalo bhavet śivādi sarvamantrāṇāmāhutyā parisaṃkhyayā homaṃ daśaguṇaṃ praddhyā śivasya parikalpayet lokapālāstramukhyānāṃ tasmādeka guṇaḥ smṛtaḥ amṛtaṃ yatparaṃ vatsa sravantaṃ manusmaret idamastvamṛtaṃ bhūyo vauṣaḍantamanusmaret homayedeka cittastu mantratanmayatāṃgataḥ śabde tatve pare tenassa siddhiphalabhāgbhavet saṃhṛtyaiva tato mantrī japaḥ prajānnivedayet tvaṃ gatirviśvavettā ca nānyonātho hi me śivaḥ paścādagniṃ visarjeta kṛtaṃ karma samāhitaḥ nirmālyaṃ tadvijānīyāt varjyaṃ vastravibhūṣaṇam nirmālyaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ dānaṃ laṃghanaṃ ca vivarjayet atha pātra vidhānena kṣālayitvā tu bhojanam śivena śivagāyatryā hṛdā caiva vidhānavit ācamya tu śucirbhūtvā śivaṃ dhyāyet punarjapet kiñcit saṃvyavahārārthaṃ prāśutaṃ punarācamet guhye manorame sthāne suviśuddhe mahītale tasyāḥ parīkṣya vijñānaṃ parigrahameva ca pāṃsunāpyayunādhanyā bhramissarvārthasādhikā jalatīrasamīpasthāṃ śuddhāṃ bhūmiṃ parīkṣayet keśāsthi kaṃṭakairhīnāṃ gartoṣaravivarjitām trihastodghāta bhūśaryyāṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitām dhautavastraiḥ śucissnātaistataḥ saṃcālayet punaḥ tataḥ kuṭavapadhītai tu palāśāśvattha mudgaraiḥ

pakveṣṭakāmayaṃ vāpi śuddhadārumayaṃ tathā dīrghaṃ dviguṇaṃ kṛtvā vistārādekabhāgikam maṇḍalasya tu dvau bhāgau bhāgaṃ kuṇḍasya kalpayet caturaśraṃ prakurvīta sughanaṃ yāgamaṇṭapam caturaśraṃ tataḥ. kuṇḍaṃ kuryād vartulameva ca mekhalāṃ tu samāṃ kuryāt tataḥ śāstravittamam hastapramāṇena atho madhya tathopara gajoṣṭhavat prakurvīta sūci puṣkarameva ca tasyopari punaścordhvamujha vā sadārubhirdṛḍham śobhanaṃ tadvijānīyāt sarvakāma phalapradam vardhanyamuṃdī pūrṇāyāmaghorāstrābhi mantritām tasyā mārgeṇa kalaśamācāryeṇoddhataṃ śanaiḥ aiśānyamaṇḍalāṃ te tu vighnaughaśamanaṃ param kṣālitaṃ cāstrabījena kavacenāva kaṃṭhitam vastrapūtāmbusaṃpūrṇaṃ pañcaratna samanvitam hemnā kaṇṭhe tathā baddhaṃ sūtrakaṇṭhamathāpi vā evaṃ vidhaṃ śivaṃ ramyaṃ śivenādhiṣṭhitaṃ guha parigrahe vāstu yāgaṃ punaryāgaṃ gaṇādhipe saṃhṛtya homadravyāṇi naivedyāṃ nidhāni ca pañcagavyaṃ caruṃ teṣāṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca mantritam tadā na vidyate siddhiḥ vidhikṣapana tena ca īśānyādiṣṭakāṣṭhāsu mukhamasya yadā bhavet śobhanaṃn tadvijānīyāt sarvakāma phalapradam pañcagavyavidhānaṃ tu tatvataḥ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhisarpiḥ kuśodakam

īśānena yajet sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tu gomūtraṃ vāmadevena gāyatryā tu kuśodakam parikalpya trayo bhāgān devasyāgre tathātmanaḥ prakṣālya pūrvavatsthālīṃ tathaivāveṣṭya vinyaset vinyasya pañcabrahmāṇi punaḥ kṣīreṇa pūrayet vrīhi śyāmākanīvārānatha vā śālibrakṣalī hṛdayaṃ ca śiraścaiva śivāṃ gāyatrameva ca yathāssantaṃ bhavedannaṃ tadarthamayārayet bhāgatrayaṃ tataḥ kuryāt yathā pūrvamudāhṛtam dantairaspṛtya mānaṃ tu pañcāṅgulyātmasaṃsthitam janapaddhyānarato maunī prākārāstre sugopitaḥ kathayanti gurossarve śucirbhūtā samāhitaḥ tasmād duḥkhapradāṃ dṛṣṭvā na siddhā saṃprayojayet kṛtvā dīkṣāṃ prakurvītaihikī siddhivarjitām atiṣora mahādurgaṃ tarateyassasiddhati videśagamanaṃ vāpi bhavet teṣāṃ vilomataḥ paśyedyaśśayitaḥ svapne tasya siddhirna vidyate dṛṣṭvā na svapate yastu yāvadabhyudito raviḥ yā śirohata svapnānte tasya siddhirna vidyate prāsādaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ nāvaṃ paryaṅgaṃ kuñjaraṃ nagam yeṣāmeka tamādvāpi pyavanaṃ mṛtulakṣaṇam āsanaṃ śayanaṃ veśma vastraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ tathā surcārnāni ca bhagnāni jvalanāsthamanāni ca cidravāsotha kṛtyañca svakaṃ prākaraṇaṃ tathā suśukyāni ca vastrāṇinicidrāṇi navāni ca

pragaikṣaṇekāśaścā prakāśaścalalakṣmivān prabhuḥ piṅge kṣaṇe śānau bhūtabālo bali * dhaḥ saṃvāhaśca vivāhaśca bindubhyo mekṣaṇaśśuciḥ vicaranti mahādevā lokapālaiḥ prapūjitāḥ kapālamālābharaṇāḥ lokapālastradhāriṇaḥ kharākhamukharamāvartormisamākulaḥ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśī ādi guhyāṣṭakāvṛtaḥ devadevastu yāmyāyāṃ bhojagandhastu nair-ṛte bhārabhūmistu saumyāyāmaiśānyāṃ lākulaṃ viduḥ subhātāya susaṃkāśa meghastanita nisvanaḥ padmarāga pratīkāśo jvalantastena tejasā mahākālaśca sarvāśca īśāno bharavastathā nīlajīmūtasaṃkāśo bhinnāñjana samaprabhaḥ subhagaḥ kāmarūpī ca guhyādguhyāṣṭakāvṛtaḥ viśveśaśca mahānādo mahadbhīmastathāṣṭamaḥ aprameyamanirdeśya mokṣastānamivāparaḥ sūkṣmamūrti mahāścāsau pavitreraṣṭabhirvitaḥ mahābala śivaścaiva sahasrākṣaḥ sthāṇureva ca dīptapāvakavarṇābhaṃ bhīmanādaṃ durāsadam pralayāmbudhanirghoṣa sthāṇvaṣṭaka samāvṛtaḥ śrīkaṇṭho nīlakaṇṭhaśca mahātejāstathaiva ca ādiguhyāṣṭakā rudrā atiguhyāṣṭakāstathā sthāṇvaṣṭakāśca paśyaite niyogādbhāmivāsinaḥ teṣāmeva samīpasthaḥ yadyattoyaṃ ṣaḍānana rudrāhete sadā śuddhāḥ kāmarūpāḥ balotkaṭāḥ

pramadābhiranindyābhirdivya yauvanaśālibhiḥ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaiḥ ḍāḍimīkusumaprabhaiḥ * * ṅga rāgasaṃkāśaiḥ kāmarūpairmanoharaiḥ * * rdhvaṃ tu bhavedanyat budyāvaraṇa saṃjñakam tasya madhye sthitā buddhiḥ vyāpinī viśvarūpiṇī sakhībhissamatulyābhidviraṣṭavayaśālibhiḥ devayonyaṣṭakaṃ tatra paritaḥ suvyavasthitaḥ paiśācaṃ rākṣasaṃ yākṣaṃ gandharvaṃ candrameva ca attordhvaṃ tu bhavedanyad guṇāvaraṇasaṃjñakaḥ tadvarṇo bhuvanāntasthā brahmāviṣṇumaheśvaraḥ tathā ca vanitāssarva puruṣāstaṃ nivāsinaḥ aṣṭau yogīśvarāṃdasti tasminnirāmayāḥ aktaṃ ca kṛtaścaiva bhairavaṃ brāhmameva ca aprataklamavijñeyaṃ nirvāṇapadapasthitaḥ utpatti sarvatatvānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca ṣaḍānana utpādayati satvāni bhavabhūtāni caiva hi tattatva dharmiṇaḥ sarve sarve cānandavigrahāḥ pañcāntakaikavīrau ca śivedasahitaiśvarāḥ ākṣāmmaddhyadeśānte saṃpūrṇavadanojvalaiḥ sevyanto nityamete tu smarabāṇanipīḍitaiḥ atordhvaṃ tu bhavedanyat rāgāvaraṇasaṃjñakam tatrāste bhagavān rāgo japākusumasannibhaḥ * mī puruṣasaṃkāśai bandhūka kusuma prabhāḥ * * * di gaṇāṃkāra visrasta mṛgalocanaiḥ tatraiva puruṣo jñeyastaddharmaguṇaraṃjitaḥ

tatraiva saṃsthitā rudrā aṣṭau ca śivatulyagāḥ vāmadevo bhavaścaivodbhavaśca tathā punaḥ aṃguṣṭhamātrasahitā mahādevāṣṭakāśśivāḥ atastradhvaṃ bhavedanyad vidyāvaraṇasaṃjñakaḥ tasya maddhya sthitā vidyā vyāpinī viśvarūpiṇī maṇḍalādhāracitrāṃgī dhyānalolāyatekṣaṇā bhāvābhāvāvilāsādhyairnityaṃ pramuditendriyaiḥ utka * * * niśvāsaiḥ payo payo harālasaiḥ tatraiva saṃsthitā rudrāstrayodaśa * * * * vāmadevaśca bhīmaśca ugraścaiva bhavastathā īśvarotha umākāntastvajeśonanta eva ca atordhvaṃ tu bhavedanyat kalāvaraṇasaṃjñakam tasya madhye kalājñeyā citravarṇānulepinī vijñānagamasaṃpannai rūpayauvanagarvitaiḥ manohāri suramyāṅgai madalālasajṛṃbhitaiḥ tatra rudro vibhurvyāpī sarvajño jñānabhāsakaḥ kalābrahmāṅgasaṃbhūtairmantravigrahadhāribhiḥ yāmyajyeṣṭhaśca rudraśca kālakālavikāraṇaḥ damanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ manonmana eva ca ata ūrdhvaṃ bhavedanyat kālasyāvaraṇaṃguha tasya madhye sthitaḥ kālo raudra sarvāṃjanāntakṛt atasī puṣpasaṃkāśaiḥ kāntimatpriyadarśibhiḥ atyartharūpasampadbhiḥ pravālālaśobhibhiḥ uccuṣmāśśāparaśśaṃḍā mātaṅgā ghorarūpiṇaḥ tatassūlagaṇāni * * * ṣadrāstathā pare

atordhvaṃ tu bhavedanyanmāyātatvaṃ sudustaram tasya madhye sthitā devī māyā tu bahurūpiṇī indranīlasamaprakhya raśmijālāvakuṃṭhitam vāmacārāstrayastatra vāmagāvāmalocanām ḍaṃgavibhramakāriṇyo ḍaṃgasnehānuraṃjitāḥ tathā ca puruṣā skanda jñeyā māyā śuklasaṃbhavāḥ athavā sarvatatvānāṃ nirgamaṃ sāmudāvikaḥ yasya tatvasya yattatvaṃ janmanyabhidhikaṃ bhavet evaṃ hi sarvatatvānāṃ tatvabhāva pradhaścidhā gaganeśo hyasādhyaśca tathā hariharāvubhau atha saṃpuṭassaṃsthāste māyātatvasya ṣaṇmukhā kṣamuśo brahmaṇohanta vidyeśānastathāparaḥ amādhinaḥ smṛtāssarve moharāga vivarjitāḥ athordhvaṃ tu bhavedanyat vidyātatvaṃ ṣaḍānana tatra vidyādhipā jñeyāḥ padmarāga samaprabhāḥ tasmādviniḥsṛtā mantrā pañcāṅgaṃ kṛtalakṣaṇāḥ acintyā ipiṇassarve sarve cānandavikramāḥ caturvidhāmṛtāssarve pārthivāpyānalānilā pāṇinācintabhedāttu mantrabhedaiḥ paraḥ śivāḥ sthānaṃ karma ca bhāvañca devatā vyāptimeva ca evaṃ hi mantrabhedastu mantrītītasya ṣaṇmukha yāvantaḥ kecanasatvāḥ sarvatatveṣu saṃsthitāḥ yādṛgrūpaṃ bhavet teṣāṃ nāmagotrañca ṣaṇmukha chāyārūpamiva sthūlaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ sūkṣmataraṃ tu taḥ prāṇī dharmādi nirmuktassukha duḥkhaphalaṃ guha

evaṃ vidyā vicāre'smin mantrabheda śivasya tu vidyordhvaṃ tu bhavedanyad vidyeśāvaraṇaṃ punaḥ aṣṭau vidyeśvarāḥ skanda sthitāstasmin vibhūtitaḥ tatra madhya mahāsena cakravat parisaṃsthitāḥ sa rahasya sakalpāni mantra tantrāṇi ṣaṇmukha prāsādāsanaparyaṅgā prākārabhūṣaṇāyudhāḥ vidyeśceśvarye racissestu divyāmṛta sukhapradaiḥ pinākī dhanurākārai bhrūbhirunnatavakṣabhiḥ sampūrṇa śaśisaṃkāśavadanābhoga maṇḍalaiḥ nātyunnataiḥ samaiḥ snigdhaiḥrviśuddhairdantapaṅktibhiḥ guptaradhraiḥ samaiḥ karṇairviromaiḥ snigdha komalaiḥ āvṛtta saṃhataiḥ pūrṇaiḥ pīnonnatapayodharaiḥ trivalītaraṃga bhaṃgodhairomarāśiprakampibhiḥ aśvatrapatrasadṛśaiḥ guhya deśairmanoramaiḥ nigūḍhajānugulphabhirnitamba vipulo jvalaiḥ suraktapāṇi pādāntaiśśaṃkhacakrāmbujāṃkitaiḥ snigdha tvak svadhalparekhābhissarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaiḥ divyagandhānuliptāṃgaiḥ divyābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ rudraiśca vividhākāraiḥ kālānalasamaprabhaiḥ athordhvaṃ tu bhavedanyat sarvaiśvarya mayaṃ śubham yogapīṭhaṃ paraṃśuddhaṃ tasmin vidyā mahātmanaḥ cārukesaraparyantaṃ sahasradalavistaram viśuddha śaktibhiṃnaṃ brahmāṅgairūpaśobhitam tatrāste bhagavān devo sarvatatveśvaroharaḥ anantakānti sampannaḥ aprameya guṇakramaḥ

vibhajyasasvakaṃ dehamaṣṭadhā parameśvaraḥ atordhvaṃ baindavaṃ tatvaṃ vimalaṃ sarvatomukham tatra vindu sthitaṃ skanda śuddhasphaṭikanirmalaḥ sakalo niṣkalaścaiva tathā sakalaniṣkalaḥ kalai śāntyādibhiryukta sakalaṃ paripaṭhyate jvālinyādibhiḥ saṃyuktaḥ sūkṣmosau parikīrtitaḥ tatosyānantato bheda sarvaśāstreṣu ṣaṇmukha niṣkalastā parāśaktiracintyā sarvatomukhī yāvijṛmbhati tatveṣu sarvatatveṣu caiva hi asyā ūrdhvaṃ nirālambaṃ nirādhāraṃ nirāmayam prakṛteḥ puruṣasaṃyogāt vidyārāgasya caiva hi vidyā sadā śivaścaiva bindoḥ śaktisamāgamāt pṛthivīmāditaḥ kṛtvā yāvattatvantu vaindavam urvī tatvāditaḥ kṛtvā devatāśca ṣaḍānana yāni nāmāni tatvānāṃ tāni tatvādhipeṣvapi brahmāṇḍādūrdhvato ye tu sarvatatveṣvavasthitāḥ teṣāṃ hi yā tanā kācit na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit sthitikāle prabhuṃjante yatvaiśvaryaṃ yathoditam sṛṣṭikāle prajāyante sarvatatvaiḥ svakaiḥ kramāt yo yasminnāśrito nityaṃ tatvatastadvidhānavit yathāntarāṇi proktāni prabhāvairya vyāptiṣu nodayāstamanaṃ skanda bhavate śiva vedinaḥ tatvairebhirnibaṃdhātmā sarvadharmaśca saṃyutaḥ nānyena śakyate māktuḥ varjyadīkṣāḥ śivātmikāḥ śṛṇuvatsaparāṃ dīkṣāṃ śivasāyujyadāṃśubhām

aiśvarya netrabījena kavacena layaṃ hunet daśabhiḥ srotasaṃ śuddhiṃ brahmāṅgairanupūrvaśaḥ pāśacchedaṃ tathā dāhaṃ prāyaścittaṃ ca homayet huṃ phaṭ kāret tatve tatve tvidaṃ karma vidhinānena ṣaṇmukha kālāgni rudratatve tu kālāgnitvaṃ viśodhayet pātāle saptametaṃ tu nyāsaṃ kṛtvā vimocayet sthāvaratvaṃ tu sadyena sārisṛpyamavātmanā paśutvamīśabījena homayedanupūrvaśaḥ sadyena vāmadevena hṛdinā ca vidhānavit garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ tathā hṛdinā niṣkrama karma cūḍā vai brahmabhiḥ smṛtā mekhalopavītaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ tapaḥ bhikṣābhivādanaṃ maunaṃ brahmacaryaṃ śamodamaḥ ahiṃsā satyamadrohastyāgaḥ kṣāṃtirapaiśunaḥ tejaḥ kṣamāśuci śaucamadro * * * * nitā trāyuṣaṃ copākarma godānaṃ ca mahāvratam tatastā plāvanebhyomaśśivāṃgairabhidhīyate kṛtvā darbhamayāṃ patnīṃ momityeva niyojayet agniṣṭomotyagniṣṭomo vājapeyokya ṣoḍaśī brahmāṅgaiḥ śivagāyatryā mahāstreṇa śivenava pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ paścāt sarvasaṃskārakarmasu śivena kurute homaṃ yasmin saṃskāra karmaṇi somasaṃsthāvasāne tu sarvamantraiḥ sakṛt sakṛt sahasrakratu madhye tu daśadajñāt paraṃ hunet

aśvamedhaṃ tato homedāhutyaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ vānaprastha tato hutvā sarvamantraiśca pañcadhā bhikṣutvaṃ homayet tasya sarvamantraiḥ sakṛt sakṛt sandhānaṃ pūrvavat kṛtvā bhedayitvā tataḥ punaḥ brahmatvaṃ vāsu devatvaṃ rudratvaṃ vidhānavit kaṭāhaṃ pūrvavadbhitvā dalarudrādigīśvarān bhayānakaṃ tu nair-ṛtyāṃ vāruṇaṃ tu mahābalam sarvavidyādhipaṃ rudramaiśānyāṃ tu niyojayet pūrvoktena vidhānena kṛtvā maṇḍala tarpaṇam śeṣeṣu niṣkṛtiṃ dadyāt viṃśaviṃśāhuti kramāt tejo nile tathā * tni ahaṃ krīḍiṣaṇe guṇe kāle māyāṃ punaśceti vidyāyāmīśvarai tathā sarvatatvādhipādharmān tatvadharmāstathāparān athāsarvatatveṣu yajedekaṃ paraṃ śivam tasyaiva dakṣiṇāmūrtau kramāt tatvādhipān nyaset pūrvavat sarvakarmāṇi sarvādhvāni samācaret cavāreva vidhiḥ proktaḥ śarīre śṛṇu sāṃpratam pūrvoktena vidhānena dhāraṇābhistu pañcabhiḥ paśuṃ saṃyojayet pūrvaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā śive karmaṇyeva kṛte tasya śivāśśedo vidhīyate yojayehīta śikhāsthāne yuktāṃ trimadhureṇa tu śaktisampuṭamadhyasthaṃ kāraṇena niyojayet yamuddiśyakṛtaṃkarma mantradaivatapūrvakaḥ yatkṛtaḥ kāmacāreṇa vidhihīnaṃ ṣaḍānana na tena karmaṇā siddhiṃ na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim

cāturvarṇahitārthāya parameśena bhāṣitaḥ devatāśca tato bhūyasteṣu mantrān yathākramam etāni pañcatatvāni sarveṣāṃ vyāpakāni tu sthūlasūkṣmavibhāgena jñātvaitāni viśodhayet devaiśca devatāssarve śuddhā smṛtāḥ bhavanti hi pṛthivyādiṣu tatveṣu kramāt tatvādhipāḥ smṛtāḥ trayastriṃśatimaṃ śambhoritareṣāsvanāmakam grahaṇaṃ na tathā bhūyaḥ paśusaṃyojanaṃ tathā guhyakena pratiṣṭhāṃ tu vidyāghoreṇa homayet ekaikasya śataṃ jñeyamāhutīnāṃ tu sādhakaiḥ garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ tathā adhikāraṃ tathā bhogaṃ layaṃ caiva vidhānavit viyogañca tathoddhāraṃ tatvasandhānameva ca pṛthivyādiṣu tatveṣu tataḥ kuryānniraṃjanam punarevaṃ pravakṣyāmi guhyādguhyataraṃ param iṣṭvā devaṃ śivaṃ śāntaṃ prāsādamamitaujasaḥ bhūyopyaṣṭa sahasraṃ tu datvā devasya ṣaṇmukha tataḥ sandhāya tatvāni punarmūlena bhedayet amanaskaṃ yathā pūrva vāsatatvaṃ ṣaḍānana pūrvoktena vidhānena yojayitvā paśuṃ śivam evaṃ dīkṣā samānā yāgacaṇḍeśvarasya tu kṛtvā pūrvaṃ guroryāgaṃ apare'hani putrakaḥ śivādīyovidātmāyaṃ gurupaṃti punarvrajet padmasaṃsthānyajanmantrī maṇḍale hṛṣṭamānasān viṣṇunaddeveśaṃ brahmāṇaṃ skandameva ca

gandhapuṣpa savitrādhyairvastrālaṃkāra vāhanaiḥ evaṃ niveditātmā tu gurupāśairvimucyate yuṣmadīyo vikalpena śaṃsyavālyaśca te sadā anujñāto yadā tena kuryāt kāryāṇi suvrataḥ vṛthā teṣāṃ vijānīyāt gururyeṣāṃ na devatā gurostu na paraṃ kiñcidityāha bhagavān śivaḥ ajñānatimirākrānte tasmājjñānamayo hi saḥ prāpnuvanti samāyukta guruṇoktena karmaṇā tasmādādau guruḥ proktaḥ paścād devo niraṃjanaḥ tasmānnāstatra boddhavyaḥ gurubhyaḥ parato guha toṣito nātrasandehastathā devāssavāsavāḥ tasmādevaṃ viditvā tu guruṃ naivāvamānayet āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ narohedgurusannidhau citrāṃ naivāgrato dhāryaṃ noṣṇaṃṣaṃ na ca pāduke nādhyāpanaṃ prakurvīta vyākhyānaṃ śiṣyasaṃgraham na śrotavyā gurornindā śāstranindā tathaiva ca gurorjyeṣṭhaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ vā bhrātaraṃ na vyati kramet dīkṣābhiṣeka jyeṣṭhena kaniṣṭhasya kadācana sarvato guravo jñeyā ye cānye pūrvadīkṣitāḥ mānyāḥ pūjyāśca te nityaṃ guravonyatra ṣaṇmukha kālenānta sthito yasya tasya mokṣāḥ kathaṃ bhavet kiṃ kiṃcid vidyate karma tasya dharmokṣa sādhanam mṛtasyāpi varaṃ skanda dīkṣākarma vidhīyate api kalpamati kuryād ekaścitta samāhitaḥ uccārya vinyasen mantrī darbhai putnīśake kṛte

saṃsthāpya dakṣiṇe pārśve tasya nāma hṛdi nyaset sammantrya pañcagavyena kṛtvā tasmin niyojayet tadevālambhanaṃ kṛtvā tasmāt saṃhṛtya homayet vinyaset sarvatatvāni tatvairdevā na tu kramāt śāntīṃ ca niṣkale sthāne dhyātvā sarvānidho mukhāt tatrāstathasya saṃlīna vinyasecchaktimaṇḍalam aṣṭau vidyeśvarān mantrī grīvāyāṃ bāhu saṃdhiṣu kalāmurasisaṃsthāpya hṛdaye nīlalohitam rāgopi rañjakastasya vidya prabodha lakṣmaṇaiḥ śabda sparśaṃ ca rūpañca rasogandhaśca pañcamaḥ nābhi meḍhrāntare buddhi mahaṅkṛtiśca sandhiṣu tatraiva yojayed vāyuṃ guhyādguhyāṣṭakāvṛtam tasyādho vāruṇaṃ tatvaṃ yāvadhā jānumaṇḍalaḥ lokādau vinyased devān brahma viṣṇu maheśvarān cintayet saptapātāla narakāṃstu tala sthitau sthāpayitvā vidhānena punarabhyarcayet kramāt pādādārabhya tān sarva aṃsau saṃsthāpya śodhayet kalpayitvā yathā pūrvaṃ paśuṃ saṃhṛtya yojayet tatvātu sarvatatveṣu tathā saṃyojayecchive kṛtvāgnau homayet paścāt tāṃ tu puttalakāṃ budhaḥ vyomānilānalāmbhorvīḥ pañcatatvāni yojayet kalābhirvyāpitāstāṃśca śānti śṛṇyādibhiḥ kramāt vyāpta sadāśivaṃ tatvaṃ śāntayā vāyurūpayā avyaktādyāvadaṃbhoṃtaṃ vyāpta caiva pratiṣṭhayā vyāpitaṃ saharudraiśca dhmātacākerā bhayam

vāyavyayāgato vāyustejasteja sadyāprataḥ yadantaraṃ yathā vyāptaṃ tasya nāmnā tu tatsmṛtaḥ śodhanān kramaṃ caiṣāṃ paśumāśritya saṃsthitaḥ śaktitrayaṃ nyaset tāvaddharmādharmau ca ṣaṇmukha manobuddhirahaṃkārairavyaktena hṛdi pudgalaḥ tasyādho hṛdayādūrdhvaṃ manile śāntimeva ca meḍhrādho yāvajānvantaṃ pratiṣṭhā varuṇā nyaset nivṛttiṃ yojayet tatra dhyātvā pūrvavadarcayet kavacādi śivāaṃgāni punaśśatyākāḥ kramāt saṃyuktāste smṛtāstatvā yomādhyākṣmāvasānikāḥ tanmātrasthe tu vijñeyā gandhādyādeśikottamaiḥ makārastu manaḥ proktaḥ * tamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ yakāraṃ prakṛtiṃ skanda parikalpyaviśodhayet gandhādi pañcasūkṣmāni sadyādibhiranu kramāt praṇavena vidhānajño homadhīta guṇatrayam guṇatrayaṃ tathā vyaktaṃ manobuddhimahaṃkṛtaḥ tilairvāghṛtasaṃmiśraistaṇḍulai rājya saṃyutaiḥ homayeta tatodiṣṭaṃ taistu pūrṇāhutiṃ tathā kramāt saṃdhāya tatvāni tayā hitvā śivaṃ nayet samayādibha nirmuktā sukha bandhād vimucyate dīkṣā saṃhārataḥ kāryāranayoravisaṃmatā ācāro'yaṃ sthitaṃ skanda sidhyartham jīvitasya tu yathā viśuddhayate dehī vipannopa ṣaḍānana ālipyāmalakaiḥ pūtaiḥ sthāpayitvā śivāṃbhasā gandhapuṣpairalaṃkṛtya udaka pāda niveśayet

saṃ cādyavastrasaṃyuktajastrajāpibhirutkṣipet ni-ṛti plavanaṃ tatra śivakṣetraṃ prakalpayet astra japtaistu tatkīlairvidikṣu kīlito bahiḥ pītena rajasāvatraṃ tasya madhye samālikhet raktena rajasā taṃ tu sarvadhānyamayena vā astreṇa prastarāṃ darbhān pyutkrameṇa tu devatāḥ srucaṃ sruvaṃ ca homānte śavasthoparivinyaset tathaivodghāṭanaṃ kuryāt niṣṇatiṃ ca ṣaḍānana aiśvaryādi vilomena mantra siṃhāsanaṃ nyaset śive śivāsane caiva tathā homaṃ samācaret arghyapādyādibhiścaiva yathāśaktyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ tataściti * nettatra candanāgarudādibhiḥ punarabhyukṣya tu pretaṃ mātra bījena ṣaṇmukha tataḥ saṃcintayennāḍīṃ tasya dehe vicakṣaṇaḥ tataḥ saṃdhāya tatvāni pādādārabhya mantravit tatra saṃdīpayed bahiṃ tamastāda pradakṣiṇaḥ avicchinnāṃ tathā rāma ghoyastrābhimantritāḥ tatojalaṃ prajed vidvān snātvā datvodakaṃ śuciḥ evaṃ vimucyate dehī samayādi vilaṃghane tathaivācāra rahitāmantyeṣṭiḥ pāśaśodhinī jñānacaryānvitasyāpi kālākasya gatirbhavet tāmasaṃ jinabhaktānāṃ prāpnuvanti * * * * caivatāni paśyanti muktisthānāni ṣaṇmukha acalaṃ bāsakaṃ śāntaṃ liṅgāśraya vivarjitaḥ yo casminnāśrito liṅgī tamādau pūjayet tataḥ

pañcarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā kṣapayitvā ṣaḍānana bhūyopyaṣṭasahasraṃ tu mūlamantreṇa homayet naiṣṭhiko dīkṣitastvena nityamapyabhicārataḥ śivārcana śivadhyāyī śivajāpi sadā bhavet dvāvevāśramiṇau śaive gṛhastha brahmacāriṇau evaṃ kāryādhikāroyaṃ yāvat saṃkrāmato nyataḥ gṛhastha brahmacāritvaṃ saṃjñāmātraṃ tu kevalam yadarthaṃ kṛta karmāṇo niyuktau parame pade pūrvasandhyā japaṃ homaṃ yacca karma kramāgataḥ yasmin varṇo sthito dīkṣāṃ prāpto dehī śivātmikām yaduktaṃ śivaśāstre'smin nyuktaṃ karmaṣaḍānana ājñeyaṃ kāraṇā jñeyā novikalpyā kadācana na puṃ hi ya*(?)rṣakaṃ vākyaṃ daivikaṃ riṣistathā na śaivaṃ viṣṇunā vākyaṃ bādhyate tu kadācana uttarottara vaiśiṣṭyaṃ sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitam * * varṇāśramācāra prāyaścittāśca laukikāḥ garbhādhānāditaḥ kṛtvā yāvadud bāhameva vā na mukhya pravatyā ca skanda lokaṃ dharmān samācaret viśuddha bhāvanā yukta śivaika gata mānasaḥ śabalaṃ karmasandeha dyatkṛtaṃ kṛtakodbhavam yamevecchati saṃprāpta śuddhakarma samāśrayet śāstrasyaivā virodhena śuddha karmājitendriyaḥ brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāśśūdrāśuddhastu sādhakāḥ śraddhadhānāna sūyāśca karmajñāḥ karma tatparāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇamṛgo yasmin carate tu ṣaḍānana

yatra viprāssadācārā yatayaśca tapodhanāḥ taddeśa kulasaṃbhūtā ācāryāśśāstrasaṃmitāḥ āpādamastakaṃ yāvat bhasmasnānaṃ dvijasya tu vaiśyasya paṭṭikā proktā śūdrasya tu tripuṃḍrakaḥ brāhmaṇasya jaṭāślaṣṇāḥ kanakāḥ parikīrtitāḥ vaiśyasyaikā śikhā sthāne tathā śūdrasya kīrtitāḥ yajñopavīta sūtraṃ tu vipre pañcasaraṃ mṛtam śūdrasyaika saraṃ jñeyaṃ nityamavyabhicāriṇaḥ hitāya deśikaṃ drāṇāḥ yathā śambhu mukhāccyutaḥ sarvaśobhābhiramye tu sarva gandha vibhūṣite śubhagrahodaye lagne śakune maṃgalairyute prasannavadanaṃ dakṣaṃ gurubhaktaṃ dṛḍhavratam śivabhaktaṃ sadāśāntaṃ śiṣyaṃ tantrasya pāragaḥ tatobhiṣecayet taṃ tu yuktāyukta vicārakaḥ śaṃkhatūryaninādaiśca nṛttageya samanvitaiḥ yāgadakṣiṇapūrveṇa paścime vottareṇa ca dvātriṃśadāṃgula vistāramucchrāyaṃ tāvadevabhiḥ pūrvavat pīṭhavinyāsaṃ tasmin saṃsthāpya pūjayet tataḥ kumbhānyathā pūrvaṃ pūrvādārabhya kalpayet aṣṭau vidyeśvarān mantrī aṣṭabhiḥ saṃniyojayet astrajaptaṃ kurusvaikaṃ śivajaptaṃ tathā paraḥ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japtvā śivākhyamabhimantrayet vidyeśvaraistataḥ paścādanantādyairyathā kramāt abhiṣekaṃ śivenaiva paścāt kurvīta ṣaṇmukhaḥ brahmasūtra pavitrādyaiḥ rbhūvya paṭṭaṃ nivedayet

śiva samīpaṃ samāśrityādhikāraṃ samarpayet adya prabhṛti yogīndra sodhikāro mayā tvayi śrotavyaṃ śivaśāstraṃ ca śrāvaṇīyaṃ tadarthinām sāyake mantra dīkṣāṃ tu yasmin tatve bhiṣicyate samayā mṛpayet paścāt brahmāṅgāni tathaiva ca deśikaṃ putrakaṃ caiva gurorvākyaṃ na laṃghayet yatnena varṇayet prājño deva jagdhaṃ ca saunikam pālānāṃ tu śivaṃ yānti sannirodhaṃ tato nyathā samayajñeṣvidaṃ jñānamatha ūrdhvaṃ na dāpayet dīkṣākāle tvamīmāṃsyā jñānadāne vicārayet aṣṭabhirdaśabhirvaiśye śūdre viṃśatyā dāpayet guhyādguhyataraṃ guhyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ prayatnataḥ na guru dveṣiṇe caiva kanyaśāstraratāya ca nānyaśāstre yathā bhaktirjñānaṃ tasminna sa yojayet na voraṇaṃ kuryāt daśad dejanasaṃ * * * * jitendriyaḥ śuciḥ snātaḥ śivajñānaṃ tu śrāvayet ādāvante ca saṃyojya guruṃ saṃbhāva bhāvitaiḥ nādhyāpayecchivajñānaṃ grahaṇāya na sandhiṣu dānopavāsaniyamāt sarveṣve teṣu ṣaṇmukha māyāśāṭhya samopetā bhūmaṃte tantra hāriṇaḥ teṣāṃ na viśvaseddharmān yadīcchecchāntimātmanaḥ saṅkrāmitādhikārastu karmasanyāsamācaret ācārya sādhakaścaiva dvāvetau tulyamaṅgalau sakāma sāyako jñeyā niṣṭhā me deśikaḥ smṛtaḥ solpaṃ homaṃ japadhyānaṃ kurute deśikassadā

pañcabhiḥ kalaśairvāpi pūrvokta vidhikalpitaiḥ dvitīye pañca brahmāṇi tṛtīyaṃga catuṣṭayam abhimantrya yathā nyāsaṃ pūrvavat snānamācaret vidyeśvarādyayā pūrvaṃ brahmāṅgāni ca mantravit caturthaṃ śivakumbhaṃ tu abhiṣiñceta pūrvavat ekasmin sarvamantrāṃśca śivakumbhaṃ tṛtīyakaḥ abhiṣekaṃ prakurvīta tato'nujñāpayet punaḥ ananujñātamantrastu na kuryānmātrikāṃ vidhim trikālamarcanaṃ japaṃ homaṃ samācaret japasya siddhi dravyāṇi pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ bāhu mātraṃ srucaṃ jñeyā puṣkaraṃ saṃni sannibhaḥ kṣālayitvāstrabījena dhāraṇābhirviśodhayet tritatvaṃ śaktibījaṃ tu yojayedubhayorapi saptarātraṃ sthitiṃ kṛtvā paścāddhomo niyojayet khasasyaṃ gomayaṃ grāhyaṃ punastatro vilepayet śivī kṛtvā tu taṃ vṛkṣaṃ śivavat prati pūjayet kṛtvā bhūta baliṃ datvā paścādakṣāṇi saṃharet pūrvaśākhodbhavaskanda jape tatpuruṣaṃ bilam ye yathāvasthitā mantrāstaistutān parikalpayet tebhisvastrotajairakṣai sarve sidhyantya saṃśayaḥ akṣamālā prakurvīta śuddhe nāstrodakena tu saptaviṃśati vā mantrī akṣamālā śubhāsmṛtā vedhayedastrabījena protayeddhṛdayena tu nirujāṃti praṇān śuddhān na bhinnāmala varjitān svastrote vinyasecchaktiṃ vīrapatrastathopari

vīrapatrasya tathā caiva paścādālabhanaṃ kuru śivībhūtaṃ tu tatsūtraṃ saṃpuṭitvā dine dine sauvarṇe rājate caiva tāmrasiddhorthakepi vā hṛdaye tu kartavyamarcanaṃ ca vilepanam āhṛtya nipuṇānakṣān astrajaptena bhasmanā tatastu pañcagavyena punargandhodakena tu yāgaṃ kṛtvā yathoddiṣṭaṃ pūrvokta mekhalaṃ yathā tritatve madhyago bhūtvā japaṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ tribhistu culakairnityaṃ yāvat saṃkhyā prapūryate japaṃ kṛtvodisaṃkṛtvā punarīśaṃ prasādhayet tamākṛṣya tathaivaiha vratamantraiḥ samācaret śivavratamitikhyātaṃ sarvadā surapūjitam śuklayajñopavītī ca jaṭāmakuṭa maṇḍitaḥ carubhūt brahmacaryasya śivāgni gurupūjitaḥ tathā vai sādhakaiṃdrāṇā vratajñeyaṃ tathātmakam śivālaye vasannityaṃ bhikṣābhakṣo jitendriyaḥ saṃvatsare vyatikrānte śivatulyo bhavediti sthāpanaṃ caiva liṃgasya yasmin sarva pratiṣṭhitaḥ tasmād vai sthāpayelliṅgaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā ācāryastatva viddhīmān viśiṣṭakulajaḥ śuciḥ sthāpakassa paraprokta śivavicchāstra saṃmataḥ na yogī na vratasnāto nā cāvācārya ucyate kuṣīku * sakhīṃ vyaṅgaṃ kṣayarogī jalodarī sarvadoṣāśrayaṃ vatsa tārkikaṃ tu vivarjayet vināgni naiṣṭhikāścaiva sthāpaneṣu vivarjayet

caturaśrayāvartulāṃ vā pradaṃgo purānvitam kuberaṃ ca tathaiśānaṃ sthāpayet teṣu devatā sthāpyaunandimahākālau śivasya puratastathā saṃpūrṇodara pārśvaṃ tu pṛṣṭhamunnatamastakam padmārthacaṃdra cakrāka śrīvatsa svastikāṅkitam caturhastaṃ pañcahastaṃ ṣaḍ hastaṃ madhyama * * śvetaraktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇa viprāditaḥ kramāt vyāmiśramapi ta gṛhyaṃ caturṇāmamaviśobhataḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ śivaliṅganidhāpayet aṣṭāṅgula vitastiṃ vā maṇiratna mayaṃ śubhaḥ prāsāde vā gṛhe ramye yatheṣṭhaṃ saṃprapūjayet liṅgavedyāsamujñeyaṃ vediliṅga samāsmṛtaḥ abhāve ratnavedīnāṃ ratnaliṅgeṣu kīrtitā madhye praveśayedyalliṅgaṃ dvau bhāgau bāhyataḥ smṛtau vihitaṃ ratnaliṃgānāṃ suṣire homa bhe * te bhāgatrayaṃ samaṃ kṛtvā tata ūrddhvaṃ parityajet sarvadoṣavinirmuktaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam vṛttaṃ caiva tamūrdhvaṃ tu prakūrvīta ṣaḍānana yava madhyaṃ tataḥ kuryāccaturaśramataḥ punaḥ aṣṭāśraṃ vā prakūrvīta suptatārākāra madhyakam mṛdaṃga kāmataṃ jeyaṃ mṛdaṃgākāra * stikaḥ maṇiratnamayaṃ liṅgaṃ punaḥ saṃsthāpya pūjayet mekhalāṃ dvādaśāṃgena praṇālaṃ cārdha bhāgikaḥ sthāpanaṃ cārcanaṃ proktamitareṇa vidhiṃ śṛṇu madhyamāṃse śasya sadvedīṃ bhaktirvedī samāsmṛtāḥ

ucchrāya dviguṇaṃ kuryā susamīkanyasasya tu kalpayīta yathoddiṣṭaṃ madhyamasthādhunā śṛṇu ūrdhvabhāge prakurvīta dvāraṃ vai madhya saṃmitu tadbhāgaṃ pūrayedbhūmau śeṣaṃ liṅga krameṇa tu suśliṣṭāmiṣṭakaiścchādyaṃ yāvat kṣetra samā * * vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena sarvakarmāṇi caivabhi prāsādaṃ ca tathā tattaliṅgamānena kārayet śukanāsā mahāsena śikharaṃ caiva laiṃgitam digaśramuśrayārdhena śukanāsasya maṇḍapam dvauliṅgādagrataḥ kuryācchukanāsasya ṣaṇmukha haṃsakṛtyātiṃ vāpi śukanāsaṃ samaṃ kuru dvau liṅgāvuttamasyoktau trīṇiliṅgānikaṃ nyaset gṛhītvā tena bhāgena prāsādaṃ parivartayet caturaśramadhobhāgamaṣṭha bhūmadhyama sthitaḥ ata ūrdhvaṃ madhyamañca samabhāgaṃ praśasyate anyathā rucitā liṃgāt garbhāntaṃ navadhā kuru sarveṣāmeva bhāgānāṃ pariṇāhastu kīrtitaḥ evaṃ kuṃḍitaṃ kṣetraṃ pariṇāhastu kīrtitaḥ tatra bhāgaṃ punastasyā yāme parikalpayet arcā bhāgaṃ tṛtīyāntu kartavyaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam sūtrayitvā suvarṇena talliṅgākṛti mut jiret utkīrya madhunājyena paścātamupalepayet madhyamāṃgulimānena taśśubhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ smṛtaḥ ati dīrgha kṛśaṃ hrasvaṃ nāthaśrayaṃ tyatra devatāḥ ślakṣṇaṃ meva saṃcinnaṃ supramāṇaṃ sudarśanaḥ

gatiṃ devasya vijñāya japadhyānādikaṃ kramāt manasā vartayet taṃ tu praṇavaṃ bindu varjitam bahiraṃgo pavītī ca dṛṣṭidūta padakramī ardharātre tu nair-ṛtye dve sandhye tu yathā divā tato malaṃ prakurvīta vastrataścāvakuṃṭhitaḥ na gulme śādvale praśmeśānopa vaneṣu ca grahītaśigno bhūtvā tu mṛttikā haraṇaṃ kuru valmīka mṛttikāṃ caiva tathā vai grāmayānikām tataḥ śaucaṃ prakurvīta mṛttikāṃ gṛhya vāriṇām ubhayoḥ saptatātapya mṛttikā śuddhimicchatā danta kāṣṭhaṃ tato mantrī bhakṣayedabhimantritam paścādyojaṃ dhyānaṃ yāvadabhyudito radhiḥ athordhvaṃ bhasmanā snānaṃ sarvakāma samṛddhaye sāvanaṃ paramaṃ skanda lepa gandha vināśanam upaspṛśya śucirbhūtvā śivaṃ dhyāyet sa nirmalam manayitāstra bījena hṛdayena tu saṃharet astreṇa kṣālayet pūrvaṃ sthāpayeddhṛdayena tu pūrvadakṣiṇe naiva tathā caivottareṇa tu uttaraṃ śiva japtaṃ tu prakurvīta pṛthak pṛthak nārācāstra prayogeṇa toya madhye punaḥ kṣipet śivajaptena bhāgena tatobhyāvartayejjale kaṃthayitvā tataḥ snāyāt śivatīrthasya madhyataḥ brahmāṅgaiḥ śiva gāyatryā mahāstreṇa śivena ca saṃhṛtyasarvamantrāṇi ninādena vidhānavit tata āyatanaṃ gacchet puṣpahasto vicakṣaṇaḥ
